items.exampleEn: My sister and I are twins, but we don't look alike.
items.exampleZh: 我妹妹和我是雙胞胎，但長得不像。

items.exampleEn: He is a nice fellow, and everyone likes him.
items.exampleZh: 他是個好傢伙，大家都喜歡他。

items.exampleEn: A relative of mine works at that hotel.
items.exampleZh: 我的一位親戚在那家飯店工作。

items.exampleEn: A gentleman opened the door for me.
Many friends came to his grandfather's funeral.
items.exampleZh: 很多朋友來參加他爺爺的葬禮。

items.exampleEn: Membership of the club costs fifty dollars a year.
items.exampleZh: 這個俱樂部的會員資格一年五十元。

items.exampleEn: My dog has been my faithful companion for ten years.
items.exampleZh: 十年來，我的狗一直是我忠實的夥伴。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your kind invitation.

items.sentenceEn: Did you get an invitation to Mia's wedding?
items.sentenceZh: 你有收到 Mia 婚禮的邀請嗎？

items.audioEn: Ladies and gentlemen, the show will begin in five minutes.
items.audioZh: 各位女士、先生，表演將在五分鐘後開始。

items.sentenceEn: My only relative in Taipei is my aunt.
items.sentenceZh: 我在台北唯一的親戚是我阿姨。

items.sentenceEn: The twins always wear different colors so people can tell them apart.
items.sentenceZh: 那對雙胞胎總是穿不同顏色的衣服，好讓大家分得出誰是誰。

items.stemEn: We sent out the wedding ____ last week.
items.stemZh: 我們上星期寄出了婚禮的請帖。

items.stemEn: A good ____ makes a long trip more fun.
items.stemZh: 有好旅伴，長途旅行會更有趣。

items.passageEn: Last month, my grandmother turned ninety. We sent invitations to all our relatives, and more than fifty people came. My twin cousins even flew in from Japan. One special guest was Mr. Lee, a kind old gentleman who has been her companion on morning walks for twenty years. He gave a brief, funny speech, and Grandma says she has never met a more cheerful fellow. His gift was a free membership to his walking club, so now Grandma can join more walks!
items.passageZh: 上個月，我奶奶滿九十歲了。我們寄邀請函給所有親戚，來了五十多個人。我那對雙胞胎表親甚至從日本飛回來。有一位特別的客人是李先生，他是一位親切的老紳士，二十年來一直是奶奶晨間散步的同伴。他的致詞簡短又幽默，奶奶說她從沒見過比他更開朗的人。他送的禮物是他健走社的免費會員資格，所以現在奶奶可以參加更多次健走了！

questions.questionZh: 有多少人來參加奶奶的生日會？
李先生和奶奶是什麼關係？

items.promptZh: 我參加葬禮時穿了黑色的衣服。
referenceEn: I wore black clothes to the funeral.
I wore black when I went to the funeral.
rubricZh: 「參加葬禮」可寫 go to the funeral、attend the funeral 等
過去的事用過去式（例如 wore）
「黑色的衣服」可寫 black clothes、black 等

items.promptZh: 我爺爺退休後，收音機成了他每天的伴。
referenceEn: After my grandfather retired, the radio became his daily companion.
The radio became my grandpa's daily companion after he retired.
rubricZh: 用 companion 表示「同伴；陪伴的東西」（例如 his daily companion）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 became、has become … since he retired 等）
